data.one_liner: Implements Microsoft's Windows User Interface (Fluent UI) in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Implements Microsoft's Windows User Interface in Flutter, offering an unofficial collection of Windows UI controls and design guidelines written based on the official documentation.
use_when: You want to build native-looking Windows desktop applications using Flutter
You prefer Microsoft's Fluent UI design system over Material or Cupertino
avoid_when: You are building a mobile-first application where Material or Cupertino is expected
You need extensive platform support outside of Windows desktop focus (though other platforms are listed)
strengths: Provides a comprehensive set of Windows-styled widgets
Supports out-of-the-box localization for a wide number of languages
weaknesses: Maintained primarily by a single developer, so pull requests may take time to review and merge
Unsupported languages may cause the app to crash
data.setup_notes: Add the package to your pubspec.yaml dependencies and run dart pub get. Ensure you use the stable channel of Flutter.
